scope: Corollary 1.3 (Eisenbud–Green–Harris in characteristic zero) of the manuscript “Commuting Division-Coefficient Forms and the Artinian Eisenbud--Green--Harris Conjecture” (preprints/Commuting-Division-Coefficient-Forms-and-the-Artinian-Eisenbud-Green-Harris-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 200 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 20fba09b5fed0f63), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let F be a field of characteristic zero, let SF = F[x1, . . . , xn] be standard graded, and let 1 ≤ c ≤ n, 2 ≤ a1 ≤ · · · ≤ ac. If a homogeneous ideal I ⊆ SF contains a homogeneous regular sequence f1, . . . , fc with deg fi = ai, there is a monomial ideal J ⊆ SF containing PF = (xa1 1 , . . . , xac c ) such that dimF (SF /J)d = dimF (SF /I)d (d ≥ 0). Moreover, J may be chosen lex-plus-powers: in each degree its monomials outside PF are the lexicographically greatest dimF Id − dimF (PF )d monomials outside PF , for the order x1 > · · · > xn.
